latest_ingest_job.label: latest_ingest_job
latest_ingest_job.sql:
SELECT j.id,
       c.name AS connector,
       j.status,
       j.records_fetched,
       j.records_inserted,
       j.records_updated,
       j.records_failed,
       j.records_deduplicated,
       j.next_cursor,
       j.error_log,
       j.metadata,
       j.started_at,
       j.completed_at
FROM public.ingest_jobs j
JOIN public.connector_registry c ON c.id = j.connector_id
WHERE c.name = 'open_states_statutes'
ORDER BY j.started_at DESC NULLS LAST, j.completed_at DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

raw_records_total.label: raw_records_total
raw_records_total.sql:
SELECT count(*)::bigint AS raw_records_total,
       count(r.sha256_hash)::bigint AS rows_with_sha256_hash,
       count(r.external_id)::bigint AS rows_with_external_id
FROM public.raw_records r
JOIN public.connector_registry c ON c.id = r.connector_id
WHERE c.name = 'open_states_statutes';

raw_records_status_counts.label: raw_records_status_counts
raw_records_status_counts.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(r.process_status, '<null>') AS process_status,
       count(*)::bigint AS count,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.processed_at IS NOT NULL)::bigint AS with_processed_at,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.error_message IS NOT NULL)::bigint AS with_error_message
FROM public.raw_records r
JOIN public.connector_registry c ON c.id = r.connector_id
WHERE c.name = 'open_states_statutes'
GROUP BY COALESCE(r.process_status, '<null>')
ORDER BY process_status;

statutes_count.label: statutes_count
statutes_count.sql:
SELECT count(*)::bigint AS statutes_count,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE jurisdiction IS NOT NULL)::bigint AS with_jurisdiction,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE jurisdiction_id IS NOT NULL)::bigint AS with_jurisdiction_id,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE source_url IS NOT NULL)::bigint AS with_source_url
FROM public.statutes;

sample_statute_row.label: sample_statute_row
sample_statute_row.sql:
SELECT external_id,
       title,
       jurisdiction,
       jurisdiction_id,
       source_url,
       status,
       created_at,
       updated_at
FROM public.statutes
WHERE external_id IN (
  SELECT external_id
  FROM public.raw_records r
  JOIN public.connector_registry c ON c.id = r.connector_id
  WHERE c.name = 'open_states_statutes'
)
ORDER BY updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, created_at DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5;

remaining_mapping_errors.label: remaining_mapping_errors
remaining_mapping_errors.sql:
SELECT r.external_id,
       r.process_status,
       r.error_message,
       r.processed_at,
       r.fetch_timestamp
FROM public.raw_records r
JOIN public.connector_registry c ON c.id = r.connector_id
WHERE c.name = 'open_states_statutes'
  AND (r.process_status IN ('failed', 'mapping_failed', 'unmapped') OR r.error_message IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY r.fetch_timestamp DESC
LIMIT 20;

connector_state.label: connector_state

openstates_raw_sample.label: openstates_raw_sample
openstates_raw_sample.sql:
SELECT r.external_id,
       r.process_status,
       r.error_message,
       r.processed_at,
       r.fetch_timestamp,
       r.raw_payload->>'title' AS title,
       r.raw_payload->'jurisdiction'->>'name' AS raw_jurisdiction_name,
       COALESCE(r.raw_payload->>'openstates_url', r.raw_payload->'sources'->0->>'url') AS upstream_url
FROM public.raw_records r
JOIN public.connector_registry c ON c.id = r.connector_id
WHERE c.name = 'open_states_statutes'
ORDER BY r.fetch_timestamp DESC
LIMIT 5;
